ui-sdk 0.1.0-beta.2 bug. An outside press on a modal dialog arms a click swallow at pointerdown. The dialog and its backdrop are gone before pointerup, so Chromium sends no click, and the swallow takes the next click: the one Space makes on the trigger. The dialog stays closed. A second Space opens it.
